scope: Pure uncalled Profile3/base4 current-state closure over immutable bytes. r2 accepts System allocation states (Finished INIT, Prepared page reservation) through validate_row_base_allocation, checks Catalog-scope Job3 relations, provenance, ledger rows and XOI inventory through the shared Catalog base seam, and fails closed with CatalogUnwired after all structural relations when a Catalog-scope semantic residual would be needed. r3 admits a row in a Transaction-stamped table only under a committed (TerminalReady outcome 1) creator whose Catalog root is Retained, bounds committed row writers by the header source, and accepts one Row-scope Reserved root per base with exactly one UndoSlot(U) item. r4 orders every committed row after its table creator (row q > the record Committed q, or the creator Ready Terminal q while unpruned) and reports a RowReserve beside another reservation as Unsupported. r5 also orders a committed Row actor still on its Ready Terminal after its table creator (Ready q > creator q) for every Transaction-stamped row and every ReleasingCompensated Row root. Profile3 Row XOI mode reproduces the inventory page. No INIT/WAL history, source selection, replay or Profile2 behaviour change.
independence: author.py is stdlib-only, imports no engine code and reuses no engine encoder; parents are pinned by sha256 below. Catalog actor D residual rows copy the Profile2 Catalog recipe only as a stand-in.

runtime_tests.reason: genesis (0-owner XOI1) and AgingStart accepted with exact census; encode reproduces bytes; descriptor/active_descriptor accessors.

live (System Undo INIT Finished at slot 32, no allocator Reserved entry) accepted: census{1 tx,1 system,2 status,1 actor,2 retained,1 table,3 rows,2 XOI owners}; Finished row excluded from active ordinals; high-water [5,0,1,0]; relations None; actors [1,2,0]; tables [1,3]; Catalog seam not touched; encode reproduces bytes.

state-system-reserved (Prepared System AllocationMaintenance reserving one page, one XOI item) accepted with reserved SystemPage, 3 owners/1 item; Prepared row is active ordinal 1; encode reproduces bytes.

state-row-reserved (A RowReserve of the free Undo15 at 33, one UndoSlot(U15) XOI item in the Forward category) accepted with reserved RowUndoSlot, 2 owners/1 item/1 chunk/5 reads; check_queue Ok; validate_relations None; row_reservation(None) RowUndoSlot; row_item Ok; encode reproduces bytes.

state-create-reserved, state-create-retained and state-create-committed-row (D committed at 38, CREATE root still Retained, one Retained A row in table 7 leased at 41) pass every structural relation (validate_relations gives CatalogCreate / None / None) and inventory check, then decode and encode both return CatalogUnwired; encode output equals input.

Profile 0/1/2/4/65535 envelopes rejected by row_profile; v1/v2 bootstrap profiles give Base(Unsupported); base 0/1/2/3/5/65535 Base(Unsupported); Root/Job 2/4 Base(Retention(UnsupportedFormat)); legacy base4 initial without XOI1 Base(Corrupt) (r2b: r2 run 1 asserted the r1 row-local Corrupt, but the XOI1 shape check now runs in the shared Catalog seam and reports Base(Corrupt); same check, same rejection).

33 relation variants each pass decode_layout and are rejected by the closure with the listed error (r3 added committed-writer-bound, create-uncommitted-row, create-uncommitted-committed-row, row-reserved-no-item, row-reserved-two-items, row-reserved-item-kind, row-reserved-twice and changed reserved-row-root; r4 adds committed-row-before-create, committed-row-before-pruned-create (Order) and row-reserved-mixed (Unsupported); r5 adds ready-writer-before-pruned-create, ready-writer-before-create and compensated-writer-before-create (Order)).

r5 R1-c: for state-ready-writer, state-ready-writer-row7 and state-compensated-writer check_queue Ok, validate_relations None, actors [1,2,0]/[1,3,0]/[1,2,1] and tables [1,3]/[2,4]/[2,3]; their negative twins ready-writer-before-pruned-create, ready-writer-before-create and compensated-writer-before-create keep the same actors and tables gives Order; state-ready-writer decodes with census{LIVE_CENSUS, transactions 0, owners 1} and encode reproduces it; the two D-unpruned states decode and encode to CatalogUnwired with encode output equal to input.

Profile3 Row XOI mode (encode_row_current over borrowed slots/root/allocator/Job3 cells) reproduces the INVENTORY page and returns (sum wal, sum steps) of header.remaining for genesis, aging, live, state-system-reserved, state-create-retained, state-row-reserved (emits the one UndoSlot item), state-create-committed-row; state-create-reserved gives Base(Unsupported) pending the Profile3 Catalog item projection.

Production source_bytes phases cover per-frame size_of inventories of every closure chain (frames, seam accessors, phases); prints ROW_BASE_SOURCE with Catalog base3 source_census/layout_source_bytes and ROW_BASE_SIZES. r3 adds the Row reservation/item, creator and header-bound chains; r5 adds the table-creator q chain to the row visitor and the compensated-root pass to tables(); B4 must stay below the 65536 native cap.
